nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: The one place the WordPress base URL is set. Sandbox while proving, production after. Not a secret - secrets are credentials.

nodes.name: Already Drafted?
nodes.notes: Always Output Data is ON deliberately. An empty [] response would otherwise produce zero items and silently skip the rest of the workflow. See Is New?.

nodes.name: Is New?
nodes.notes: True when the lookup found no project -- the empty item from Already Drafted?'s Always Output Data has no id. False when a real project object came back, which routes to Drop.

nodes.name: Get Area Term
nodes.notes: REST via ?rest_route= rather than /wp-json/. The query-string form needs no Apache rewrite, so it works on the WP Staging clone as well as on production. See n8n/README.md.
